record: JOI Phase 5C v2 corrected metric preregistration

scope.purpose: Re-evaluate the exact v1 retrieval outputs with a corrected metric contract only.
scope.allowed_change: Evaluation aggregation and metric interpretation only.

frozen_inputs.answerable_query_definition: A query with at least one human-labeled relevant candidate.
frozen_inputs.empty_expected_definition: A query whose human label sets empty_retrieval_expected=true.

MRR_answerable.definition: Mean of reciprocal ranks over answerable queries only.
MRR_answerable.reciprocal_rank: 1/rank of the first human-labeled relevant candidate in filtered ranking; 0.0 if no relevant candidate is retrieved.
MRR_answerable.denominator: Number of queries with at least one human-labeled relevant candidate.

empty_retrieval_correctness.definition: For empty-expected queries only, the fraction where filtered_candidates is empty.

metrics.Precision_at_3: Accepted candidates (relevant or acceptable_secondary) divided by up to 3 filtered candidates; empty expected cases are evaluated separately for emptiness.
metrics.Recall_at_3: Human-labeled relevant candidates retrieved in the first 3 filtered positions divided by the number of human-labeled relevant candidates.
metrics.stale_retrieval_rate: Harmful_stale candidates retrieved divided by all filtered candidates.
metrics.forbidden_retrieval_rate: Forbidden candidates retrieved divided by all filtered candidates.
metrics.provenance_coverage: Filtered candidates with valid source turn and policy references divided by all filtered candidates; empty result sets pass vacuously.
metrics.false_recall_rate: Filtered candidates not labeled relevant or acceptable_secondary, excluding stale and forbidden candidates from this rate.
metrics.deterministic_replay: True only when a separately preregistered replay produces identical canonical semantic output for every query: seed IDs, unresolved surfaces, graph snapshot ID, PPR parameters and convergence, raw candidate IDs and scores, filtered candidates and scores, rejected candidates and reasons, policy/provenance references, and injection/influence counts.
metrics.hub_popularity_contamination: Rate of hub-driven candidate selections that are not human-labeled relevant or acceptable_secondary, reported separately for high-degree hub queries.
metrics.latency: Median and p95 local retrieval latency, descriptive only and not a decision gate.

replay_gate.execution: A separate explicit replay is allowed only after this contract is frozen.
replay_gate.rerun_scope: Replay the same 18 queries with the same commit, graph, corpus, labels, K, PPR parameters, and policy filters.
replay_gate.byte_equality: Receipt byte equality is not required because receipt IDs, latency, and timestamps may vary.
replay_gate.pass_condition: Every canonical semantic output is identical and all frozen controls remain satisfied.

decision.PASS: All thresholds pass and deterministic replay is proven.
decision.FAIL: A completed valid evaluation misses any numerical threshold or safety invariant.
decision.INCONCLUSIVE: Replay, labels, manifests, or required evidence are incomplete or cannot establish the contract.

historical_quality_observations.ppr-query-008: One unaccepted candidate; inspect ranking/path only.
historical_quality_observations.ppr-query-014: One relevant candidate omitted; inspect K-limit and hub-ranking behavior.
historical_quality_observations.claim: These remain genuine v1 retrieval-quality observations regardless of the v1 MRR aggregation defect.
